userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	userDashboardInfo = self.view.custom.userDashboardInfo
	if userDashboardInfo['userDashboardId']:
		userDashboardInfo['isFavorite'] = not (userDashboardInfo['isFavorite'] or False)
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboard(userDashboardInfo, userId)
	else:
		userDashboardInfo['isFavorite'] = True

		userDashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addUserDashboard(userDashboardInfo, userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.userDashboardInfo')
	if msg:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
	
	view.custom.showActionsMenu = False
	
	return

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	dashboardId = self.view.custom.dashboardInfo.dashboard.dashboardId
	
	if userId is None or dashboardId is None: 
		msg = 'Invalid settings userId - %s dashboardId - %s "%(userId, dashboardId)
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
		return
		
	isDefault = not (self.view.custom.userDashboardInfo['isPrimary'] or False)		
		
	if isDefault:
		#We should only have one default dashboard, so we'll go through the users dashboard and set all others to false
		userDashboards = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.dashboard.getUserDashboards({'userId': userId}))
		for userDashboardInfo in userDashboards:
			system.perspective.print("Update user dashboard settings %s"%userDashboardInfo['userDashboardId'])
			userDashboardInfo['isPrimary'] = False
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboard(userDashboardInfo, userId)

	userDashboardInfo = dict(self.view.custom.userDashboardInfo)
	if userDashboardInfo['userDashboardId'] is not None:
		userDashboardInfo['isPrimary'] = not (userDashboardInfo['isPrimary'] or False)
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboard(userDashboardInfo, userId)
	else:
		userDashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addUserDashboard({'isPrimary': True, 'isFavorite': False, 'userId' : userId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId}, userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.userDashboardInfo')

	if msg: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
	else: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Dashboard set as default'})
	
	self.view.custom.showActionsMenu = False
	
	return

config.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	dashboardId = self.view.custom.dashboardInfo.dashboard.dashboardId
	guestUserId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId({'userName': 'Guest'})
	
	if userId is None or dashboardId is None or guestUserId is None: 
		msg = 'Invalid settings userId - %s dashboardId - %s guestUserId - %s"%(userId, dashboardId, guestUserId)
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
		return
	
	#We should only have one default dashboard, so we'll go through the users dashboard and set all others to false
	userDashboards = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.dashboard.getUserDashboards({'userId': guestUserId}))
	for userDashboard in userDashboards:
		system.perspective.print("Updating Guest dashboard settings %s"%userDashboard['userDashboardId'])
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboardField(userDashboard['userDashboardId'], 'isPrimary', False, userId)

	userDashboardId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('userDashboardId', system.kanoa.dashboard.getUserDashboards({'userId': guestUserId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId}))
	if userDashboardId:
		userDashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboard({'isPrimary': True, 'isFavorite': False, 'userId' : guestUserId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId, 'userDashboardId': userDashboardId}, userId)
	else:
		userDashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addUserDashboard({'isPrimary': True, 'isFavorite': False, 'userId' : guestUserId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId}, userId)

	if msg: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': msg})
	else: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Dashboard set as default'})
	
	self.view.custom.showActionsMenu = False
	
	return
